decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-18 MODIFY establishing its question-and-answer format and flexible question-count policy.
The AI chapter is separately classified as a basic non-question-and-answer chapter, so the source Requirement's question-and-answer policy does not apply.
The pre-interview chapter is separately classified as a basic non-question-and-answer chapter and remains unchanged by the source Requirement's format change.
The candidate already has a message-18 MODIFY replacing its prior chapter-length guidance with flexible question-count guidance subject to the overall word limit.
The source chapter's format and question-count policy do not alter curation of the existing 250-question set; the separate curation instructions in message 18 are already represented.
Changing the source chapter to a question-and-answer format does not itself modify the independently defined answer-layer structure, whose message-18 changes are already represented.
The source decision concerns one chapter's format and question-count policy and does not change how global perspectives are integrated into the manuscript.
The source chapter's format and question-count policy do not change the project duration target, flexibility, or milestone order.
The source policy requires questions to fit within the existing overall word limit but does not change the already established 50,000-word manuscript cap.
The source chapter's format and question-count policy have no effect on the completed pre-project writing-test deliverable.
